create_reacher_robot: create a Reacher robot instance with 2D action space and 9D observation space for reaching tasks
create_pusher_robot: create a Pusher robot instance with 7D action space and 55D observation space for pushing tasks
create_striker_robot: create a Striker robot instance with 7D action space and 55D observation space for striking tasks
create_thrower_robot: create a Thrower robot instance with 7D action space and 48D observation space for throwing tasks
apply_action_to_manipulator: apply a clipped torque action vector to the robot joints via set_motor_torque
